newsitem.title: VENEZUELA: More Venezuelans believe conditions worsening - poll.
newsitem.headline: More Venezuelans believe conditions worsening - poll.

text.p: One year after Venezuela implemented a stiff package of economic reforms, Venezuelans increasingly believe conditions will get worse before they get better, a poll published Monday in leading daily El Universal showed.

A March survey conducted by local pollsters Mercanalisis showed that 39 percent of Venezuelans believe conditions are set to get worse -- up from 37 percent in December and 34 percent in September last year, El Universal reported.

The poll of 801 Venezuelans in the country's six largest cities also showed that 30 percent foresee conditions improving in the near future, down from 34 percent in December. However, 20 percent believed the economic climate had improved up until now - - up from 18 percent in December.
El Universal did not report a margin of error for the poll, which showed greater pessimism in the capital than in provincial cites.
